title: Technical English — Course 4, Semester 2 — Pilot Variant 6

tasks.prompt: Listening 1. When will the network lesson begin?
tasks.audioText: The computer networks tutor will introduce network protocol terminology on Thursday at ten. Students should bring the network glossary and meet in Room 18. The lesson will compare the roles of addressing, routing and error checking in data communication. The tutor will use a simplified network diagram and a short glossary exercise.

tasks.prompt: Listening 2. Which glossary is required for the network lesson?
tasks.audioText: The computer networks tutor will introduce network protocol terminology on Thursday at ten. Students should bring the network glossary and meet in Room 18. The lesson will compare the roles of addressing, routing and error checking in data communication. The tutor will use a simplified network diagram and a short glossary exercise.

tasks.prompt: A network protocol defines rules that allow devices to exchange information. Different protocols may support addressing, routing, error detection or application-level communication. A network diagram can show how devices are connected, but it does not describe every detail of the protocol. Engineers should identify the relevant standard and consult current technical documentation when describing system behaviour. Reading 1. What does a network protocol define?
options: Rules that allow devices to exchange information

tasks.prompt: Why is a network diagram not enough to describe every protocol detail?
options: Because it shows connections but not every detail of protocol behaviour

tasks.prompt: Network protocols ___ rules for exchanging information.
Choose TWO functions that network protocols may support.
A set of rules for exchanging data between devices is a network ___.
A network report uses an unclear protocol name. What should you ask?
options: I will leave the name out.
Could we confirm the exact protocol and version in the technical documentation?
I will invent a standard name.

tasks.prompt: Put the stages of network protocols in a logical order.
options: Check the protocol name and version
Describe its role in the system
correctOrder: Check the protocol name and version
Describe its role in the system

tasks.prompt: Write 80–100 words explaining why network documentation should identify the protocol and its version. Mention two functions that protocols may support.
tasks.rubric: 8 points total: task completion and relevant content (0–2); clear organisation and logical linking (0–2); grammar and sentence structure (0–2); accurate technical vocabulary, spelling and punctuation (0–2). Minor errors are acceptable if meaning remains clear.
